body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0111 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Registry Run key persistence (user-writable path) - Sysmon 13 Run/RunOnce; Details Temp/Users"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0111"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1547.001"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION")
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "13"
    ($e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\CurrentVersion\\Run/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\Winlogon\\Shell/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\Winlogon\\Userinit/ nocase)
    ($e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /\\Temp\\/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /\\Users\\/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /\\AppData\\/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /\\Downloads\\/ nocase or $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /\\Public\\/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
